[Thinking]
Okay, I need to find out when the Philadelphia Phillies won the World Series. Let me start by recalling what I know about the Phillies. They're a Major League Baseball team based in Philadelphia. I remember they've won a couple of World Series, but I'm not exactly sure of the years. 

The first thing that comes to mind is that they have two championships. One was a while back, maybe in the 1980s or earlier. Oh, right, they won in 1983. Wait, no, maybe that was when they lost. Let me think. The 1983 team was pretty good, but I think they might have lost the World Series that year.

Then there's the 2008 season. I remember the Phillies winning the World Series then because it was a significant event. They beat the Tampa Bay Rays in that series, right? The clinching game was in Citizens Bank Park, and they celebrated there. Carlos Ruiz catching the last out, and everyone stormed the field. That was definitely a big deal. So 2008 is one.

Now, going back further, when was their first World Series win? The Phillies are one of the older teams, so maybe early 20th century. I think it was the 1950s? Wait, no, the 1950 team lost to the New York Yankees. Then in the 1980s, maybe? Let me check. Oh, wait, the 1983 team I mentioned earlier lost to the Baltimore Orioles. So maybe it was 1980? Yes! The 1980 season. The Phillies won the World Series that year, defeating the Kansas City Royals in six games. Mike Schmidt was a key player then. So 1980 and 2008 are the two World Series championships.

Wait, let me confirm. The Phillies were established in 1883, so their first World Series win was in 1980? That seems a bit late. Did they not win before that? I think they had some good teams in the early 1900s. Let me think. The 1915 season? I remember something about the 'Whiz Kids' in the 1950s, but they lost. Oh, right, the 1915 Phillies. That's probably their first World Series appearance and win. But wait, did they actually win? Or did they lose? 

Looking into it more, the Phillies did win the National League pennant in 1915 but lost the World Series to the Boston Red Sox. Then again in 1950, they won the NL but lost to the Yankees. So their first World Series win wasn't until 1980. Then again in 2008. So the answer should be 1980 and 2008. Let me check a few more things. The 1980 team had Mike Schmidt, Steve Carlton, and they beat the Kansas City Royals. The 2008 team had players like Chase Utley, Ryan Howard, and Cole Hamels. Yes, those are the two years they've won the World Series. So the user should be told that the Philadelphia Phillies won the World Series in 1980 and 2008.
[/Thinking]

ក្រុមហ៊ុន Philadelphia Phillies ឈ្នះ World Series ពីរដង ហើយគឺក្នុងឆ្នាំ **1980** និង **2008**។

1. **ឆ្នាំ 1980**: 
   - Phillies បានយកឈ្នះនៅក្នុង NLCS ទល់នឹង Montreal Expos (3-2 ក្នុងស៊េរី) ហើយបន្ទាប់មកបានយកឈ្នះក្រុម Kansas City Royals នៅក្នុង World Series (4-2 ។ក្នុងស៊េរ៊ី)ដោយមានការលេងល្អរបស់អ្នកលេងល្បីៗដូចជា Mike Schmidt និង Steve Carlton។ នេះជាលើកដំបូងគេបរាជ័យលំដាប់ខាងជើងអាមេរិក (NL) ក្នុង​ វីរក្ដិត្យវគ្គជម្រុះ។

2. **ឆ្នាំ 2008**: 
   - Phillies បានលេងល្អខ្លាំងជាមួយអ្នកលេងល្បីៗដូចជា Chase Utley, Ryan Howard, និង Cole Hamels។ ពួកគេបានយកឈ្នះក្រុម Tampa Bay Rays ក្នុង World Series (4-1 ក្នុងស៊េរ៊ី)។ ការលេងរបស់ Cole Hamels ក្នុង World Series បានឲ្យគាត់ទទួលបាន MVP។ 

ក្រុមនេះមានប្រវត្តិយូរលើសពី 140 ឆ្នាំ (បង្កើតក្នុងឆ្នាំ 1883) ប៉ុន្តែទើបមានជ័យជម្នះ World Series ពីរដង។ ពួកគេឈ្នះ NL pennants ចំនួន 7 ដង ក៏ប៉ុន្តែចាញ់ច្រើនគ្រា (គ្រា ១៩១៥, ១៩៥០, ១៩៨៣, ២០០៩ និង ២០២២)។
